mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ai_agent WHERE agent_id=#{agentId}

SELECT version_id,agent_id,version_no,system_prompt,route_snapshot,tool_snapshot,capability_snapshot,budget_snapshot,published_by,published_time FROM ai_agent_version WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} ORDER BY version_no DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent SET status='1',update_time=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND status='0'

UPDATE ai_agent a JOIN ai_agent_version v ON v.version_id=#{versionId} AND v.agent_id=#{agentId} SET a.published_version_id=v.version_id,a.update_by=#{updateBy},a.update_time=NOW(),v.published_by=#{updateBy},v.published_time=NOW() WHERE a.agent_id=#{agentId} AND a.status='0' AND v.published_time IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT a.agent_id,a.status,a.published_version_id,v.version_no,v.system_prompt,v.route_snapshot,v.tool_snapshot,v.budget_snapshot FROM ai_conversation c JOIN ai_agent a ON a.agent_id=c.agent_id LEFT JOIN ai_agent_version v ON v.version_id=a.published_version_id WHERE c.conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_agent SET draft_json=#{draftJson}, draft_version=draft_version+1, update_by=#{updateBy}, update_time=NOW() WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND draft_version=#{expectedVersion} AND status='0' AND published_version_id IS NULL
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_run (conversation_id,agent_id,agent_version_id,status,route_snapshot,tool_snapshot,budget_snapshot,idempotency_key,create_time,update_time) VALUES (#{conversationId},#{agentId},#{agentVersionId},#{status},#{routeSnapshot},#{toolSnapshot},#{budgetSnapshot},#{idempotencyKey},NOW(),NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE run_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(run_id)
mapper.select: SELECT run_id FROM ai_run WHERE conversation_id=#{conversationId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
SELECT run_id FROM ai_run WHERE run_id=#{runId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(sequence_no), 0) + 1 FROM ai_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId}
SELECT sequence_no FROM ai_run_event WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND idempotency_key=#{idempotencyKey}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_outbox_event(aggregate_type,aggregate_id,event_type,payload_json,idempotency_key,status,attempts,available_time) VALUES(#{aggregateType},#{aggregateId},#{eventType},#{payloadJson},#{idempotencyKey},'PENDING',0,NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE outbox_id=LAST_INSERT_ID(outbox_id)
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_outbox_event SET status='SENT', sent_time=NOW(), attempts=attempts+1 WHERE outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE ai_outbox_event SET attempts=attempts+1, available_time=DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL LEAST(attempts * 5, 300) SECOND) WHERE outbox_id=#{outboxId} AND status='PENDING'

UPDATE ai_run SET worker_id=#{workerId}, lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_time=NOW(), update_time=NOW() WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status=#{expectedStatus} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT') AND (lease_until IS NULL OR lease_until <= NOW())

UPDATE ai_run SET lease_until=#{leaseUntil}, heartbeat_time=NOW(), update_time=NOW() WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND worker_id=#{workerId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT') AND lease_until > NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT run_id, status, worker_id, lease_until, recovery_count FROM ai_run WHERE lease_until IS NOT NULL AND lease_until < NOW() AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT') AND recovery_count <= #{maxRecoveryCount} ORDER BY update_time LIMIT 100
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_run SET recovery_count=recovery_count+1, worker_id=NULL, lease_until=NULL, update_time=NOW() WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT')

UPDATE ai_run SET status='FAILED', error_code=#{errorCode}, worker_id=NULL, lease_until=NULL, finished_time=NOW(), update_time=NOW() WHERE run_id=#{runId} AND status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_run_checkpoint(run_id,sequence_no,state_json,create_time) VALUES(#{runId},#{sequenceNo},#{stateJson},NOW()) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE state_json=VALUES(state_json)
mapper.select: SELECT version_id,agent_id,version_no,system_prompt,route_snapshot,tool_snapshot,capability_snapshot,budget_snapshot,published_by,published_time FROM ai_agent_version WHERE agent_id=#{agentId} AND version_no=#{versionNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_run r JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.conversation_id=r.conversation_id SET r.status=#{status}, r.update_time=NOW(), r.finished_time=IF(#{status} IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT'),NOW(),r.finished_time) WHERE r.run_id=#{runId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1) AND r.status=#{expectedStatus} AND r.status NOT IN ('SUCCEEDED','FAILED','CANCELLED','TIMED_OUT')
mapper.select: SELECT e.event_id,e.run_id,e.sequence_no,e.event_type,e.event_json,e.idempotency_key,e.create_time FROM ai_run_event e JOIN ai_run r ON r.run_id=e.run_id JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.conversation_id=r.conversation_id WHERE e.run_id=#{runId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1) ORDER BY e.sequence_no LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT run_id, agent_id, agent_version_id, route_snapshot, tool_snapshot, budget_snapshot, status, worker_id, lease_until, recovery_count FROM ai_run WHERE run_id=#{runId}

SELECT r.run_id, r.route_snapshot, r.budget_snapshot, v.system_prompt, (SELECT m.content FROM ai_message m WHERE m.conversation_id=r.conversation_id AND m.role='user' ORDER BY m.message_id DESC LIMIT 1) AS user_prompt FROM ai_run r JOIN ai_agent_version v ON v.version_id=r.agent_version_id WHERE r.run_id=#{runId}
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_run r JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.conversation_id=r.conversation_id WHERE r.run_id=#{runId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1)

SELECT m.call_id,m.run_id,m.channel_id,m.model_id,m.status,m.request_started,m.request_finished,m.usage_json,m.price_snapshot,m.estimated_cost,m.actual_cost,m.error_json FROM ai_model_call m JOIN ai_run r ON r.run_id=m.run_id JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.conversation_id=r.conversation_id WHERE m.run_id=#{runId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1) ORDER BY m.call_id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}

SELECT t.tool_call_id,t.run_id,t.tool_key,t.idempotency_key,t.status,t.request_json,t.result_summary,t.started_time,t.finished_time FROM ai_tool_call t JOIN ai_run r ON r.run_id=t.run_id JOIN ai_conversation c ON c.conversation_id=r.conversation_id WHERE t.run_id=#{runId} AND (c.user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1) ORDER BY t.tool_call_id DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{limit}
SELECT agent_id, agent_key, name, status, published_version_id FROM ai_agent WHERE agent_key=#{agentKey}

SELECT COUNT(1) FROM ai_conversation WHERE (user_id=#{userId} OR #{userId}=1)
AND title LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
